answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, like a lantern hung at the gate: the stake is slashed if the same operator spins up many fake identities. A shared reputation trellis then links past trades, so a new identity starts with no history and cannot borrow trust from others. Faking a thousand agents would mean funding a thousand stakes across a dune of empty accounts, each costing real capital and time, while honest agents keep one stake and build history once.
